messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- As of 2026-05-29, Oskar is the primary on-call for the Ember team. [valid 2026-05-29 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-05-29]
    earlier: As of 2026-01-15, Diego is the primary on-call for the Ember team. [valid 2026-01-15 to 2026-05-29; recorded by standup/ember/2026-01-15]
- The billing API depends on the ledger service for invoice postings. [valid 2025-01-09 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-09-2]
- Priya Raman is the primary on-call for the Atlas team as of 2025-07-30, when on-call passed from Tomasz. [valid 2025-07-30 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-07-30]
    earlier: Tomasz is the primary on-call for the Atlas team as of 2025-06-19, until the next rotation. [valid 2025-06-19 to 2025-07-30; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-06-19]
    earlier: Priya Raman is the primary on-call for the Atlas team as of 2025-05-13, until the next rotation. [valid 2025-05-13 to 2025-06-19; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-05-13]
    earlier: Tomasz is the primary on-call for the Atlas team as of 2025-04-03, replacing Priya Raman. [valid 2025-04-03 to 2025-05-13; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-04-03]
    earlier: Priya Raman is the primary on-call for the Atlas team starting 2025-02-12. [valid 2025-02-12 to 2025-04-03; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-02-12]
- Diego is on call for Cinder to start the year. [valid 2025-01-09 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-09]
- The notifier depends on the bus for delivery events, so it is down whenever the bus is down. [valid 2025-02-11 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-02-11]
- The webhook dispatcher depends on the bus for outbound events, so it is down whenever the bus is down. [valid 2025-02-11 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-02-11-2]
- On 2026-04-08, the Atlas team observed that webhooks' request volume halved following the client rollout, and since it was not their service, they flagged it. [valid 2026-04-08 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-04-08]
- As of 2026-04-14, Farah is primary on-call for the Dune team, having taken over from Tomasz. [valid 2026-04-14 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-04-14]
    earlier: As of 2026-03-11, Tomasz is primary on-call for the Dune team, having taken over from Farah. [valid 2026-03-11 to 2026-04-14; recorded by standup/dune/2026-03-11]
    earlier: As of 2026-01-16, Farah Haddad is primary on-call for the Dune team, having taken over from Tomasz. [valid 2026-01-16 to 2026-03-11; recorded by standup/dune/2026-01-16]
    earlier: As of 2025-12-10, Tomasz Nowak has the Dune team pager, having taken over from Farah. [valid 2025-12-10 to 2026-01-16; recorded by standup/dune/2025-12-10]
    earlier: As of 2025-11-17, Farah still has the Dune team pager. [valid 2025-11-17 to 2025-12-10; recorded by standup/dune/2025-11-17]
- As of 2025-05-15, the pager for webhooks rings the Boreal team instead of the Ember team. [valid 2025-05-15 to now; recorded by handover/2025-05-15-webhooks]
    earlier: As of 2025-03-03, the pager for webhooks rings the Ember team instead of the Boreal team. [valid 2025-03-03 to 2025-05-15; recorded by handover/2025-03-03-webhooks]
- The job scheduler depends on the feature-flags service. [valid 2025-04-29 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-04-29]
- As of 2026-01-16, Tomasz is off the Dune team on-call rotation. [valid 2026-01-16 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-01-16]
- As of 2026-05-29, Diego is off the Ember team on-call rotation. [valid 2026-05-29 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-05-29]
    earlier: As of 2026-01-15, Oskar is off the Ember team on-call rotation. [valid 2026-01-15 to 2026-05-29; recorded by standup/ember/2026-01-15]
- As of 2026-04-13, the Ember team still owns the reporting service. [valid 2026-04-13 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-04-13-2]
- The reporting service no longer depends on the ledger service for the nightly balance export; as of 2025-09-23 it uses the bus as its source. [valid 2025-09-23 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-23]
    earlier: The reporting service depends on the ledger service for the nightly balance export. [valid 2025-01-21 to 2025-09-23; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-21]
- As of 2025-09-30, the billing API depends on the feature flag service. [valid 2025-09-30 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-09-30]
- The indexer depends on the product catalog for product documents. [valid 2025-01-30 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-30]
- On 2026-03-20, on-call for the Boreal team passed from Marcus to Lena. [valid 2026-03-20 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-03-20]
